name: kxinsurrection
title: Will Trump invoke the Insurrection Act before the deadline?
settlement: This market resolves to Yes if the President of the United States has invoked the Insurrection Act to deploy the U.S. military and/or the federalized National Guard within the United States before the stated deadline date. It resolves No if no such invocation occurs before that date.
decideContext: You are estimating how much a news item shifts the implied probability (in percentage points) that Trump will formally invoke the Insurrection Act before the market's deadline. Resolution requires an actual legal invocation triggering military/National Guard domestic deployment, not just threats or unrelated deployments.
